raw_goal: I want to learn about the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem to build my own MCP server. I want papers that present applications, use cases, or domain-specific MCP server implementations — concrete examples of MCP being deployed (e.g., MCP for code analysis, MCP for scientific workflows, MCP for healthcare data, MCP for enterprise tools). I want to see what kinds of problems people are solving with MCP. Not interested in: Benchmarks, MCP security/attack papers, or pure MCP protocol-design proposals without an application.
lexical_query: Model Context Protocol applications use cases implementations code analysis scientific workflows healthcare enterprise
